description.value: Wok Box is a Canadian fast-casual franchise founded in Edmonton in 2004 and now operating over 60 locations coast to coast, drawing its menu from more than 10 Asian culinary traditions — rice boxes, noodle boxes, wings, poutines, and more. The Fort St. John outpost sits in a commercial strip on 96 Street, making it a convenient resupply stop for cyclists travelling through northeastern BC's Peace Region. The chain emphasizes freshness and offers diet-accommodating options including vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-friendly dishes.

address.value: 9317 96 Street, Fort St. John, BC V1J 6V5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The corporate website (wokbox.ca) confirms Wok Box is an active fast-casual Canadian chain and explicitly lists a Fort St. John location under British Columbia on the contact/location page, corroborating the OSM record. The FAQ page explicitly confirms vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-friendly options are available chain-wide. No location-specific amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are available from the corporate site, and no individual store page for Fort St. John was captured.
concerns: Corporate website does not list the specific street address or local phone number for the Fort St. John location, so OSM contact details could not be independently verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-casual restaurant with Fort St. John confirmed as a current location on the corporate website; a practical meal and resupply stop for cyclists in the Peace Region.
